rows: What is AMOC and why does it matter?
Thermohaline circulation; keeps NW Europe ~5-8°C warmer; weakening under freshwater forcing
What happens during El Niño in SE Asia?
Drought + fires (warm water moves east → Walker Circulation disrupts → Indonesia gets less rain)
Why are eastern ocean boundaries cold and dry?
Cold upwelling currents (California/Humboldt/Benguela) driven by Ekman transport
El Niño years suppress monsoon; ITCZ migration shift also implicated
What is the polar vortex disruption?
AO-negative weakens polar vortex → cold Arctic air escapes to midlatitudes → extreme winter events
Convergence at gyre centers → floating materials accumulate
